_comment: The payoff was a second ability triggered on ON_BANISH, which is not a trigger name -- dispatch falls back to the raw string and matches nothing, so it never ran. 'Whenever THIS banishes' means the banish this card just did, so it is a CONDITIONAL in the SAME ability, reading the `banished` ref BANISH now records. No new engine event needed. The test was an AND of two IDENTICAL REF_PITCH_IS clauses with pitch:'SAME_COLOR', which is not a pitch value. 'Another card with the same colour' compares the card just banished against the ones this card banished EARLIER, which is what the banished_cards list is for.
